name: WinTech Nano (Suzhou) Co Ltd.
summary: Wintech Nano (Suzhou) Co., Ltd. provides commercial laboratory services in the field of electronics and semiconductor in China and internationally. It provides solutions for failure analysis, non-destructive testing, electrical failure analysis, physical failure analysis, surface analysis, trace elemental analysis, chemical analysis, crystal analysis, pull/shear test, burn-in, reliability test, one-stop material analysis, and destructive physical analysis device, as well as R&D services. The company also offers automotive-grade chip testing, material analysis, and other testing services. Wintech Nano (Suzhou) Co., Ltd. was founded in 2004 and is based in Suzhou, China.
